providers.label: AgentMail
providers.blurb: Not connected · send email from an inbox

fields.label: Inbox address
fields.hint: An existing AgentMail inbox. Stageflow does not create one.

fields.label: API key
fields.hint: Needs to read the inbox and send messages.

fields.label: Webhook secret (optional)
fields.hint: Lets agents receive mail for this inbox. Sign webhooks to /api/agent-inbound/<connection id> with this secret (HMAC-SHA256 of the body in the x-agentmail-signature header).

providers.yamlExample:
connections:
  - id: support-inbox
    provider: agentmail
    config:
      inbox: support@agentmail.to
    secrets:
      apiKey: env:AGENTMAIL_API_KEY

providers.label: Slack
providers.blurb: Not connected · post as a bot

fields.label: Bot token
fields.hint: xoxb-… from your Slack app (OAuth & Permissions). Needs chat:write.

fields.label: Workspace ID (optional)
fields.hint: Pins the connection to one workspace, such as T0123ABCD.

fields.label: Signing secret (optional)
fields.hint: Lets agents receive messages from this workspace. From your Slack app (Basic Information). Point Event Subscriptions at /api/agent-inbound/<connection id>.

recipient.label: Channel id
recipient.placeholder: C0123ABCD (channel, group, DM or user id)

providers.yamlExample:
connections:
  - id: ops-slack
    provider: slack
    secrets:
      botToken: env:SLACK_BOT_TOKEN

providers.label: Telegram

fields.label: Bot token
fields.hint: From @BotFather. People must start the bot before it can message them.

fields.label: Bot username (optional)
fields.hint: Fails the check if the token belongs to another bot.

fields.label: Webhook secret (optional)
fields.hint: Lets agents receive messages from this bot. Use it as secret_token in setWebhook with the URL /api/agent-inbound/<connection id>.

providers.yamlExample:
connections:
  - id: alerts-telegram
    provider: telegram
    secrets:
      botToken: env:TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN

providers.label: iMessage
providers.note: Sending iMessage uses the Spectrum SDK packages (optional dependencies). On a Free or Pro Photon project, each recipient must be a project user and must text their assigned line once before Stageflow can message them.

fields.label: Photon project secret
fields.hint: Stored on this host. Never written to connections.yaml.

providers.yamlExample:
credentials:
  - id: photon-main
    provider: photon
    secrets:
      projectId: env:PHOTON_PROJECT_ID
      projectSecret: env:PHOTON_PROJECT_SECRET
connections:
  - id: alerts-imessage
    provider: imessage
    credential: photon-main

providers.label: WhatsApp Business
providers.note: Enable WhatsApp for the project in the Photon dashboard first. Uses the Spectrum SDK packages (optional dependencies). Stages pin an approved template per recipient.

fields.label: Photon project secret
fields.hint: Stored on this host. Never written to connections.yaml.

providers.yamlExample:
credentials:
  - id: photon-main
    provider: photon
    secrets:
      projectId: env:PHOTON_PROJECT_ID
      projectSecret: env:PHOTON_PROJECT_SECRET
connections:
  - id: orders-whatsapp
    provider: whatsapp
    credential: photon-main
providers.stageExample:
to: "+14155550123"
    template:
      name: order_update
      languageCode: en_US
      bodyParams: ["{{message}}"]

CHANNEL_INVALID_INPUT.reason: The settings are not valid for this provider account
CHANNEL_INVALID_INPUT.hint: Check the values (for example an unknown inbox or a different workspace) and try again. If the file is hand-edited, fix the entry and restart.

CHANNEL_DISABLED.hint: Enable it, or remove it from the stage.

CHANNEL_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED.reason: This provider is not supported here, or its SDK is not installed
CHANNEL_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED.hint: iMessage and WhatsApp need the Spectrum SDK packages, which are optional dependencies.

CHANNEL_SECRET_UNAVAILABLE.reason: A secret for this connection is not set on the host
CHANNEL_SECRET_UNAVAILABLE.hint: Set the environment variable each secret names (or its _FILE form) on the host, or use Replace to store one, then check again.

CHANNEL_RESOURCE_LIMIT.reason: The request or connections.yaml is too large

CHANNEL_STORAGE_FAILED.reason: Stageflow could not read or write connections.yaml or the secret store on this host
CHANNEL_STORAGE_FAILED.hint: Check that the data directory is writable.

CHANNEL_UNAUTHORIZED.reason: Credentials were rejected or lack a required permission
CHANNEL_UNAUTHORIZED.hint: The provider refused the credential: it is invalid, or it lacks a permission this provider needs (for AgentMail, reading the inbox and sending). Check the key and its permissions, then try again.

CHANNEL_AUTH_FAILED.hint: Replace the secret with a valid one, then check again.

CHANNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED.hint: This is usually temporary. Check the network and try again.

CHANNEL_TIMEOUT.reason: The provider did not answer in time

CHANNEL_RATE_LIMIT.reason: The provider is rate limiting this account

CHANNEL_WINDOW_CLOSED.hint: Pin an approved template on the stage so it can message first.

CHANNEL_TARGET_INVALID.reason: The pinned recipient is not valid for this provider

CHANNEL_RECIPIENT_REJECTED.reason: The provider will not message this recipient
CHANNEL_RECIPIENT_REJECTED.hint: For iMessage on a Free or Pro Photon project, add them as a project user and have them text their assigned line (the "Texts on" number) once.

CHANNEL_SEND_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.reason: The message may or may not have been sent
CHANNEL_SEND_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.hint: Check the provider before sending again. Stageflow never resends it automatically.

CHANNEL_OPERATION_CONFLICT.reason: That already exists, or the key was reused with different content
